rules.reason: a person manages only their own mailboxes; no public read, and the password is not in the row at all (it is in the owner's write-only identity vault)
the owner may see where the sync has got to; only system_mail_sync writes it, because a hand-edited cursor skips or repeats mail
the owner may read the transport facts about their own mail (list headers, folder, UID); only system_mail_sync writes them

explicit, because owners may otherwise update and delete their own rows by default: a hand-edited or deleted cursor makes the next pass skip or re-download mail. The sync writes it; an admin can still repair it
explicit for the same reason: these rows are the dedupe record, and deleting one makes its message look new to the next pass
the page shows a sign-in prompt to visitors and only the signed-in owner's own accounts to anyone else
